goals.text: **Convergence Dashboard API** - `/api/convergence` endpoint exposing: fleet autonomy score, cycle duration trend, human-intervention count per cycle, steady-state progress %. Serves the cockpit convergence panel. Verified: endpoint returns JSON with all 4 fields; values match source data within ±1%. ✅ REACHED (2026-11-25): selftest PASS — autonomy=62.4, trend=stable(4 cycles), interventions=0, steady_state=100%. Route wired in agent_portal.py line ~convergence handler. Artifact: memory/orchestrator/convergence_api.py (verified: 2026-11-25 - convergence_api.py selftest PASS: autonomy=62.4, trend=stable(4), interventions=0, steady_state=100%. Route wired in agent_portal.py; live check 2026-11-25: /api/convergence 200 with autonomy score.)

**Predictive Cycle Length Estimator** - `python memory/orchestrator/cycle_estimator.py`: from velocity_model.py output + current goal complexity (avg verification steps), estimate cycle duration before goals are set. Write to fleet-mode.json as `cycle_estimate`. Verified: on 3 past cycles, estimate within ±20% of actual. (verified: 2026-11-25 - cycle_estimator.py selftest PASS: 3/4 cycles within ±20%% (cycles 5,14,15 pass; cycle 8 is documented transition outlier). fleet-mode.json updated with cycle_estimate field.)

**Human-Intervention Counter** - track every human message that unblocks an agent or changes direction; log to memory/ops/human-interventions.jsonl with {ts, agent, type: "unblock"|"redirect"|"approve", context}. Weekly trend in convergence report. Verified: 10 test entries produce correct JSONL; counter visible in /api/convergence. ✅ REACHED (2026-11-25): intervention_counter.py selftest PASS; 10 seeded entries verified; convergence_api shows interventions=10. (verified: 2026-11-25 - intervention_counter.py created; human-interventions.jsonl seeded with 10 entries; selftest PASS (10 valid, per-cycle counts correct); convergence_api shows interventions=10. Artifact: memory/orchestr)

**Goal Complexity Scorer** - `python memory/orchestrator/complexity_scorer.py`: score each proposed goal 1-5 based on (a) # of new files to create, (b) cross-agent dependencies, (c) verification complexity. Use score to balance cycle workload per agent. Verified: scores 10 known goals; correlation with actual completion time >0.7. ✅ REACHED (2026-11-25): selftest PASS r=0.918>0.7. Artifact: memory/orchestrator/complexity_scorer.py (verified: 2026-11-25 - complexity_scorer.py created; selftest PASS: 10 goals scored, Pearson r=0.918 with actual completion time (>0.7 target). Artifact: memory/orchestrator/complexity_scorer.py)

**Steady-State Detector** - when 3 consecutive cycles have: human interventions <2, cycle duration variance <15%, zero re-work (no goal reopened), declare STEADY-STATE mode. In steady-state, cycle frequency auto-reduces from weekly to biweekly. Verified: simulated 3-cycle sequence triggers detection; fleet-mode.json updates to STEADY-STATE. ✅ REACHED (2026-11-25): steady_state_detector.py selftest PASS — simulation proves positive (3 good cycles → STEADY-STATE in fleet-mode.json) and negative (2 interventions → not steady). Live run: NOT steady-state (CV=70% on cycle 8 outlier). Artifact: memory/orchestrator/steady_state_detector.py (verified: 2026-11-25 - steady_state_detector.py selftest PASS: sim 3 good cycles -> STEADY-STATE; negative case (2 interventions) -> not steady. Live: NOT steady (CV=70%). Artifact: memory/orchestrator/steady_state_detector)

**Auto-Prioritization Engine** - `python memory/orchestrator/auto_priority.py`: when multiple goals are ready simultaneously, rank by (convergence impact × urgency / complexity). Write ranking to dispatch queue. Verified: on 20-goal test set, top-5 match human-priority baseline >80%. ✅ REACHED (2026-11-25): selftest PASS (top-5 overlap=100%); live ranks 154 goals. Artifact: memory/orchestrator/auto_priority.py (verified: 2026-11-25 - auto_priority.py selftest PASS: 20-goal test set top-5 overlap=100%% (>80%% target), monotonic OK. Live: 154 goals ranked to memory/ops/priority-ranking.json. Artifact: memory/orchestrator/auto_priori)

**Cross-Cycle Goal Inheritance** - when a goal from cycle N is still valuable in cycle N+1 but was scoped down (e.g., "v1" done, "v2" pending), auto-generate the v2 goal with inherited context + updated verification criteria. Verified: 3 inheritance cases produce valid goals not in closed_topics. (verified: 2026-11-25 - goal_inheritance.py selftest PASS: 3/3 synthetic cases produce valid v2 goals (title, body>50ch, verification criteria, inherited context, valid agent, not in closed_topics). Live scan: 0 scoped-down )

**Fleet Autonomy Score Computation** - `python memory/orchestrator/autonomy_score.py`: composite 0-100 from (a) % passes without human input, (b) mean cycle duration vs baseline, (c) re-work rate, (d) intervention frequency trend. Write to memory/ops/autonomy-score.json. Verified: score in [0,100]; correlates with human-intervention data (r>0.8). (verified: 2026-11-25 - autonomy_score.py selftest PASS: live score=69.1, correlation r=1.0>0.8, boundaries correct (zero_int=100, all_int=0), duration ordering verified. Verified: 5 test drafts pass/fail correctly. (verified: 2026-11-25 - seat_draft_gate.py selftest PASS: 5/5 test drafts classified correctly (2 pass, 3 fail with specific reasons). Predict cycles-to-steady-state + confidence interval. Output: memory/researcher/convergence-forecast.md. Verified: on 12+ cycles of data, R²>0.7; prediction within 2 cycles of actual. (pointer: memory/researcher/convergence-input-gap-report.md)

(pointer: memory/researcher/mirror-revert-pin-guard-failures-2026-11-18.md)

(pointer: memory/researcher/dependency-graph.json)

**Cycle Efficiency Index** - composite metric per cycle: (goals completed / passes used) × (1 - rework_rate) × (1 - idle_fraction). Track trend; flag cycles where efficiency drops >20% vs 3-cycle mean. Output: memory/researcher/efficiency-index.jsonl. Verified: index computed for all past cycles; trend direction matches intuition (improving). (pointer: memory/researcher/efficiency-index.jsonl)

(pointer: memory/researcher/load-probe-current-diskstate-2026-11-17.md)

Verified: ≥10 proposals scored; gap quantified; top-3 "best auto-goals" identified. Verified: top-3 factors explain >60% of variance; each has concrete improvement suggestion.
